records.name: Modelling and Simulation in Materials Science and Engineering
records.scope_notes: Materials simulation from atomistic to macroscopic scales, multiscale models, data-driven materials discovery and computational tools. Contributions must advance modelling strategies or processing-structure-property understanding; new laboratory experiments are not required by this scope.

route.conditions: Choose subscription access; paid gold open access is optional. Original research has no stated length limit. Topical reviews, roadmaps and viewpoints are invited.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None: journal-specific policy explicitly states no other publishing charges.

fee_evidence.note: The journal-specific charges section separately confirms free subscription publication, no submission charges and no other publishing charges; gold open access is optional.

difficulty.basis: Discovery record only; no acceptance-difficulty judgment established.

records.name: Journal of Physics A: Mathematical and Theoretical
records.scope_notes: Theoretical and mathematical physics, statistical mechanics, nonlinear dynamics, numerical algorithms, quantum information and field theory. Mathematical or algorithmic work needs an explicit physical motivation; a generic algorithm demonstration is insufficient.

route.conditions: Choose subscription access; paid gold open access is optional. Research papers are usually about 10,000 words; letters have a nine-page/6,500-word limit. Reviews and perspectives are normally invited.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None: journal-specific policy explicitly states no other publishing charges.

fee_evidence.note: The journal-specific charges section separately confirms free subscription publication, no submission charges and no other publishing charges; gold open access is optional.

difficulty.basis: Discovery record only; no acceptance-difficulty judgment established.

records.name: Journal of Physics: Condensed Matter
records.scope_notes: Theoretical and simulation studies in condensed matter, electronic structure, phase transitions, surfaces, soft matter and physics of materials. Papers must contain new fundamental condensed-matter science; routine property calculations without new physics do not meet the stated scope.

route.conditions: Choose subscription access; paid gold open access is optional. Papers are normally at most 8,500 words; letters have a six-page/4,500-word limit. Reviews are mainly commissioned, although submitted reviews can be considered.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None: journal-specific policy explicitly states no other publishing charges.

fee_evidence.note: The journal-specific charges section separately confirms free subscription publication, no submission charges and no other publishing charges; gold open access is optional.

difficulty.basis: Discovery record only; no acceptance-difficulty judgment established.

records.name: Classical and Quantum Gravity
records.scope_notes: Numerical relativity, gravitational theory, cosmology, quantum gravity and analysis of existing gravitational data. New exact solutions must have physical or mathematical significance; a solution-finding technique must be successfully applied.

route.conditions: Choose subscription access; paid gold open access is optional. Research articles and letters require substantive advances. Topical reviews and roadmaps are normally commissioned.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None: journal-specific policy explicitly states no other publishing charges.

fee_evidence.note: The journal-specific charges section separately confirms free subscription publication, no submission charges and no other publishing charges; gold open access is optional.

difficulty.basis: Discovery record only; no acceptance-difficulty judgment established.

records.name: Physical Chemistry Chemical Physics
records.scope_notes: Physical chemistry, chemical physics and biophysical chemistry, including theory, computation and data science. Computational chemistry and simulation need significant physical-chemical insight; no new physical laboratory work is necessary for the computational routes.

route.conditions: Official indexed journal policy explicitly states no submission or publication fees for the subscription route. Gold open access carries an optional APC. Direct journal and author-guideline page retrieval returned HTTP 403; evidence remains search-index text pending independent page access.
route.other_mandatory_costs: No page or colour charges stated in indexed publisher policy; direct full-page verification remains outstanding.

fee_evidence.note: Indexed official journal text explicitly says no fees to submit or publish, distinguishes the free subscription route from optional paid gold open access, and lists research and review article types.
Indexed official publisher text states no page charges or submission fees and free use of colour figures; direct full-page access was not established.
Indexed official policy says APCs are payable only for accepted gold open-access articles and there are no submission fees.

difficulty.basis: Discovery record only; no acceptance-difficulty judgment established.

records.name: Soft Matter
records.scope_notes: Theoretical and computational soft-matter research, including colloids, polymers, liquid crystals, active matter, self-assembly, interfaces and rheology. Mechanistic insight and significant interdisciplinary advances are expected.

route.conditions: Indexed official policy explicitly states no fees to submit or publish through subscription access; gold open access is optional and paid. Communications are limited to approximately 2,000 words/four journal pages; perspectives are invited. Direct page retrieval returned HTTP 403.
route.other_mandatory_costs: No page or colour charges stated in indexed publisher policy; direct full-page verification remains outstanding.

fee_evidence.note: Indexed official journal text confirms the free subscription route, optional APC-funded open access, theoretical/computational scope and peer review.
Indexed official publisher text states no page charges or submission fees and free use of colour figures; direct full-page access was not established.
Indexed official policy says APCs are payable only for accepted gold open-access articles and there are no submission fees.

difficulty.basis: Discovery record only; no acceptance-difficulty judgment established.

records.name: Journal of Computational Physics
records.scope_notes: Advanced numerical methods and mathematical modelling for physical problems, including scientific machine learning and cross-disciplinary computational methods. Authors should compare with existing approaches and support reproducibility with sufficient software/data and methodological detail.

route.conditions: Official indexed journal text states that subscription publication has no author publication fee. Gold open access is an optional paid route. The guide for authors and journal page returned HTTP 403; submission fees, page/colour charges and article-type exceptions were not independently resolved.
route.other_mandatory_costs: Unknown pending accessible current author-guide verification.

fee_evidence.note: The official ScienceDirect journal record indexed via this DOI states no publication fee for the subscription option; this does not by itself establish no submission or ancillary fees.
Direct current author-guide retrieval returned HTTP 403, so separate submission and ancillary-cost checks remain incomplete.
Official publisher policy says some titles outside economics also levy submission fees and directs authors to the journal guide; publisher-wide absence cannot be assumed.

difficulty.basis: Discovery record only; no acceptance-difficulty judgment established.

records.name: Physical Review E
records.scope_notes: Statistical, nonlinear, complex-systems, soft-matter, fluid, plasma and computational physics, including physically relevant machine learning. Significant and substantive additions to the literature are required; purely computational or existing-data studies can fit.

route.conditions: APS explicitly lists Physical Review E as having no publication fees under traditional subscription access. Paid gold open access, print colour and reprints are optional; online colour is free. An explicit official no-submission-fee statement was not located, so full free-route eligibility remains unverified.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None identified for standard online publication; submission fee remains separately unresolved.

fee_evidence.note: APS Help Center explicitly names Physical Review E among journals with no fees associated with traditional subscription publication.
Author instructions state online colour figures are free; print colour and reprints are optional paid choices. No explicit submission-fee statement was found.
APS identifies Physical Review E as hybrid and states the listed APC applies to gold open access.

difficulty.basis: Discovery record only; no acceptance-difficulty judgment established.

records.name: Acta Crystallographica Section A: Foundations and Advances
records.publisher: International Union of Crystallography (co-published with Wiley)
records.scope_notes: Fundamental and mathematical structural science; crystallographic algorithms, analysis methods, software, AI and machine learning for structural science. Theoretical studies and reuse of existing structural data fit; routine new structure determinations are generally outside Section A's emphasis.

route.conditions: Use the standard subscription route; paid open access is optional. Research papers normally do not exceed 15 journal pages; short communications normally do not exceed two pages. Lead-article proposals are discussed with editors. Structural data must be supplied where applicable.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None for the standard route: publisher explicitly lists no submission, page or colour charges.

fee_evidence.note: Official journal page explicitly states articles are free to publish, with no submission or page charges; its cost table also confirms no colour charges and makes open access optional.
Author-services page confirms that paid open access is optional and there are no other page charges.

difficulty.basis: Discovery record only; no acceptance-difficulty judgment established.

records.name: Acta Crystallographica Section B: Structural Science, Crystal Engineering and Materials
records.publisher: International Union of Crystallography (co-published with Wiley)
records.scope_notes: Computational and theoretical structural science, crystal-structure prediction, structure-property relationships, polymorphism, machine learning and crystallographic database studies. Reuse of existing structural data is relevant; articles need interpretable structural or materials advances.

route.conditions: Use the standard subscription route; paid open access is optional. Supply structural data where applicable. Research, feature, review and best-practice articles are supported; check the relevant category with the current author notes.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None for the standard route: publisher explicitly lists no submission, page or colour charges.

fee_evidence.note: Official journal page explicitly states articles are free to publish, with no submission or page charges; its cost table also confirms no colour charges and makes open access optional.
Author-services page confirms that paid open access is optional and there are no other page charges.

difficulty.basis: Discovery record only; no acceptance-difficulty judgment established.

notes: Ten journal candidates across computational physics, numerical methods, theoretical physics, chemistry, materials simulation and structural science. The scope descriptions select computational, theoretical or existing-data work; they do not propose new physical laboratory experiments.

Six routes have explicit, accessible journal-specific evidence covering submission and standard publication and are marked verified_free. Two RSC routes have explicit official indexed free-route statements but direct HTTP 403 access, and two further routes retain unresolved submission/ancillary checks; these four remain needs_verification.

All records describe a standard subscription route. Optional gold open-access APCs do not make that route mandatory; institutional agreements are not prerequisites for standard subscription publication.

Metrics and difficulty judgments are intentionally left to independent ranking work. Official IUCr Section A and B about pages report 2025 submission counts and acceptance-rate labels; denominator and cohort definitions should be checked before interpreting them.
Excluded untrusted search results using look-alike domains sciencedirectelsevier.com and onlinetandf.com; neither was treated as an Elsevier source.
This discovery pass is an agent evidence check, not a manuscript-scope determination or human scientific review.

Journal of Computational Physics scope, review-article eligibility and absence of a formal page limit were read on its accessible official Elsevier Shop page; the linked journal author guide was blocked, including direct verification of its review-process details.
